policies.title: Grenada: Belizean ordinary passports
policies.summary: Grenada's active Embassy nationality schedule directly lists Belize in its no-visa-required cohort for visitor travel.
conditions: Applies to a current ordinary Belizean passport for short visitor travel.
The schedule's no-visa category means a visa is not required; authorized stay, work, residence, carrier checks and final admission remain separate.
The actively linked schedule was updated April 2024 and should be rechecked if Grenada publishes a replacement.

policies.title: Belizean ordinary passports: Panama visa-free short visits
policies.summary: Panama's current Embassy visitor schedule expressly includes Belize in its no-visa-required cohort.
conditions: The Embassy page states a maximum stay of three months for the named no-visa-required cohort.
This covers ordinary Belizean passports and visitor travel only; passport validity, onward travel, funds, work, residence, carrier checks and final admission remain separate.
